items.title: Install the Pebble SDK automatically when a watchface build needs it

handoff.outcome: make build/clean install Pebble SDK 4.33.1 when none is active and stop visibly before cleaning if installation fails; SDK removed from agent@tinni (816,443,392 bytes freed). The delivery commit also added unrelated .serena/ config files by mistake.

checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && make -C watchface HOME="$tmp" clean build && unzip -p watchface/build/watchface.pbw appinfo.json | grep -q 55cd5be7-0481-48aa-a20e-2edf1d8b713b && rm -rf watchface/build

tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp" watchface/build' EXIT && mkdir -p watchface/build && echo old > watchface/build/watchface.pbw && ! make -C watchface HOME="$tmp" PEBBLE_SDK_VERSION=0.0.0 clean build && grep -qx old watchface/build/watchface.pbw && ! test -e "$tmp/.local/share/pebble-sdk/SDKs/current"

missing-sdk-install-build.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && make -C watchface HOME="$tmp" clean build && unzip -p watchface/build/watchface.pbw appinfo.json | grep -q 55cd5be7-0481-48aa-a20e-2edf1d8b713b && rm -rf watchface/build

failed-install-preserves-bundle.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp" watchface/build' EXIT && mkdir -p watchface/build && echo old > watchface/build/watchface.pbw && ! make -C watchface HOME="$tmp" PEBBLE_SDK_VERSION=0.0.0 clean build && grep -qx old watchface/build/watchface.pbw && ! test -e "$tmp/.local/share/pebble-sdk/SDKs/current"
